title: Figure 5. Air-Breathing MHD Engine illustration with inset proof-of-concept photo
description: Color illustration of a conceptual high-speed air-breathing MHD engine shown as an elongated translucent blue duct with a flared inlet and red electrode bands, set against a black background. An inset photograph shows a purple-glowing plasma tube from the operating proof-of-concept experiment. Captioned "Figure 5. Air-Breathing MHD Engine," attributed to work investigated by Lockheed Martin Aeronautics.
